But in general, when possible, it's better to wash hands to reduce the risk of illness. I also think about the scientific evidence supporting handwashing. Studies have shown that proper handwashing can reduce the incidence of diarrhea and respiratory infections, especially in children. So from a health standpoint, it's definitely beneficial. Another point is that washing hands before eating is a simple act that can have a big impact.
